description: Besançon Vélos en libre service Ginko Vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Besancon. The data are available in GBFS format and make it possible to know: List of stations (geolocation, name, address, identifier) Status of stations (number of bikes available and free spaces) The flow comes from Ginko Vélo and is converted to GBFS by the transport.data.gouv.fr team. Coverage: Ville de Besancon. The portal shows the English title as "Besançon Self-service bikes Ginko Bike" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Besancon. Its keywords include velo, gbfs, velocite. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, HTML. The listing shows 2025-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
